page.overview:
What is Naruto Anime?

Naruto Anime belongs to Naruto. The plot of the Naruto series is told across several different time periods, known as Part I, Part II, the Blank Period, New Era: Part I, and New Era: Part II.

These time periods are themselves broken into several story arcs comprised of manga chapters, anime episodes, and/or other media types. This article attempts to present these sections of the story in order, though the chronology sometimes differs between different adaptations of the same material.
